topic: Rust vs Node web server load test

youtube.title: Rust vs Node Web Server: 9x More Requests? (Real Load Test) 🦀 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Rust vs Node vs Python web server load test: the same JSON API on the same 2 CPU cores. Rust handled 162,047 requests per second, Go 103,346, Node 17,284 and Python (FastAPI) 16,229. Median of 3 runs with wrk.

📌 In this short:
✅ Rust (Axum) served about 9x more requests per second than Node (Express)
✅ Peak memory: Rust 26 MB, Go 40 MB, Python 151 MB, Node 390 MB
✅ Go had the lowest tail latency at 1000 connections (full video)

🎬 Full load test (4 rounds, all the code): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-QZ5EO1nQs4
💻 Code: https://github.com/ShreyashSarage/Youtube_automation/tree/main/longform/web-bench/project

Follow for a new Rust lesson every day at 10 AM IST, from zero to pro 🦀
💬 What should I load test next? Tell me in the comments 👇
